org.name: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service

hazard: Outdated first aid training of prison staff

promises.quote: staff in the Offender Management Unit at HMP Liverpool have reviewed the sentence calculations for the current population and found no other prisoners to have a miscalculated sentence.
promises.summary: Reviewed sentence calculations and found no other miscalculated sentences

promises.quote: first aid training is being provided to all Custodial Managers who carry out orderly officer duties, ensuring that there will be an additional trained member of staff on duty at all times, and Operational Support Grade staff will also be trained.
promises.summary: Providing first aid training to Custodial Managers and Operational Support Grade staff

concerns.quote: HMP Liverpool miscalculated Luke Myer's extended sentence of 12 years from November 2012 by erroneously applying Section 226A CJA 2003 and with regard to parole section 246A CJA 2003
During the course of the inquest evidence was heard from two members of Prison discipline staff that they had last been trained in first aid respectively 10 and 6 years ago
concerns.hazard: outdated first aid training of prison staff

promises.quote: The Governors of each prison are required to ensure that there are sufficient numbers of staff trained in first aid on duty, and at HMP Lewes at least two trained nurses and one trained member of prison staff are available at all times. Two on-site first aid trainers will be delivering first aid training to staff as part of the prison's monthly training provision, and a one-day refresher course will be introduced to ensure that training levels are maintained. promises.summary: Introduce refresher first aid training for long-serving staff

concerns.quote: Prison staff are often first responders to medical emergencies of prisoners, but not all have received first aid training
concerns.hazard: lack of first aid training among prison staff

concerns.quote: One frontline prison staff member gave evidence that he had not received training in 16 years of working for HMPS and felt he needed refresher training
concerns.hazard: lack of refresher first aid training for long-serving prison staff

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that prison staff lacked up-to-date first aid training, raising concerns about their ability to respond to medical emergencies.
